dense_rank_split.dense_rank_source: the Phase 10 Dense list in the dev lists (depth 100)

grid: alpha in (0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1) x convex triples (dense, bm25, relevance-hop) in tenths

host.processor: ARMv8 (64-bit) Family 8 Model 1 Revision 201, Qualcomm Technologies Inc

tie_rule: gold_recall@2048 sum; then the smaller alpha (closest to P10-C); then the larger w_dense; then the larger w_bm25
